'''Beate Sodeik''' is a German cell biologist who is Professor of Medical Sciences at the [[Hannover Medical School]]. Her research considers the biology of viral infections, with a particular focus on [[Herpes simplex virus]].

== Early life and education ==
Sodeik was an undergraduate student in the [[University of Bonn]], where she studied biology. She earned a Diploma in Cell Biology, where she analysed [[autophagy]] in ''[[Amoeba proteus]]''.<ref name=":0" /> After graduating, she received a [[DAAD scholarship]], and moved to the [[Columbia University Vagelos College of Physicians and Surgeons]].<ref name=":0" /> During her time at Columbia, Sodeik worked on integrin receptors of human neutrophils. She was a doctoral student in [[cell biology]] at the [[European Molecular Biology Laboratory]] in [[Heidelberg University]]. Her research considered the assembly of the ''[[Vaccina virus]]'' (cowpox).<ref>{{Cite thesis|title=Das Assembly des Vaccinia-Virus|date=1992|language=German|first=Beate|last=Sodeik|oclc=722777102}}</ref> After earning her doctorate, Sodeik returned to the [[United States]], where she joined [[Ari Helenius]] at [[Yale University]]. At Yale, Sodeik studied the early phases of [[Herpes simplex virus]].<ref name=":0" />

== Research and career ==
Sodeik was made a Senior Scientist at [[Hannover Medical School]] in 1997. She completed her habilitation in the cell biology of [[DNA virus]]es and the maturation of ''[[Vaccinia]]''.<ref>{{Cite thesis|title=Die Zellbiologie komplexer DNA-Viren die Reifung des Vaccinia-Virus; der Zelleintritt von Herpes-Simplex-Virus|date=2001|language=German|first=Beate|last=Sodeik|oclc=722946902}}</ref> She was eventually promoted to Professor.{{when|date=September 2021}}{{citation needed|date=September 2021}} Since starting her postdoctoral research, Sodeik has explored the cell biology of Herpes simplex virus.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Bettina|title=Prof. Dr. Beate Sodeik|url=https://www.resist-cluster.de/en/about-us/research-team/prof-dr-beate-sodeik/|access-date=2021-09-26|website=RESIST|language=en-US}}</ref> She is interested in virus-host interactions, virus assembly and viral replication.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|title=Medizinische Hochschule Hannover : Sodeik lab|url=https://www.mhh.de/en/mhh-institutes/virology/research/sodeik-lab|access-date=2021-09-26|website=www.mhh.de}}</ref>
